narrative_engine.thesis: trend up context (H4 stack up · D1 stack up · EMA spread 0.67 ATR · price holds above Day VWAP) set the LONG bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 3.499-3.612 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 3.438; the first objective pays 2.23R at 3.602.
